title: THE CONTROLS LIST IS UP FOR A WHILE, THEN F1
why: The HUD spec of 2026-10-15 (decision 6): nothing of the HUD should stand in the play space beside the character. The compact controls list, which a new player has up for his first raids, stood on the vitals beside the feed, the biggest box on the screen, for the whole raid. It now shows for the first 45 seconds of a raid, while F1 is held, and for 12 seconds after F1 is pressed; the rest of the time one line, F1 controls, stands over the feed. F1 on a list that is not up brings it back, and the full list still comes with the next press.
now: The compact controls list now shows for the first 45 seconds and while F1 is held, then a one line hint.
